mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inquiry ( inquiry_no, requirement_id, connection_id, buyer_tenant_id, title, currency, category, quantity, unit, delivery_place, delivery_date, quote_deadline, payment_terms, spec_text, attachment_key, status, create_by ) VALUES ( #{inquiryNo}, #{requirementId}, #{connectionId}, #{buyerTenantId}, #{title}, #{currency}, #{category}, #{quantity}, #{unit}, #{deliveryPlace}, #{deliveryDate}, #{quoteDeadline}, #{paymentTerms}, #{specText}, #{attachmentKey}, #{status}, #{createBy} )

UPDATE inquiry SET title = #{title}, category = #{category}, quantity = #{quantity}, unit = #{unit}, delivery_place = #{deliveryPlace}, delivery_date = #{deliveryDate}, quote_deadline = #{quoteDeadline}, payment_terms = #{paymentTerms}, spec_text = #{specText}, attachment_key = #{attachmentKey}, update_by = #{updateBy} WHERE id = #{id} AND buyer_tenant_id = #{buyerTenantId} AND status = 'open' AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT c.id AS connectionId, i.id AS inquiryId, i.status AS inquiryStatus FROM connection c JOIN inquiry_invite ii ON ii.supplier_tenant_id = c.supplier_tenant_id AND ii.is_deleted = 0 JOIN inquiry i ON i.id = ii.inquiry_id AND i.is_deleted = 0 WHERE c.id IN #{cid} AND c.is_deleted = 0 AND c.buyer_tenant_id = #{buyerTenantId} AND i.buyer_tenant_id = #{buyerTenantId} AND i.requirement_id = c.requirement_id AND i.status IN ('open', 'quoting', 'awarded')
mapper.update: UPDATE inquiry SET quote_deadline = #{quoteDeadline}, update_by = #{updateBy} WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
